text.tspan: Business semantics, automatic HTTP metadata, durable inbox and best-effort live delivery
Flushes inside the caller's transaction; commit or rollback follows the business write.
Runs after the response · independent transaction · best effort · no target or business detail.
NOTIFICATION CREATION · persisted inbox + best-effort live push
muted → stop; no row, no push
Redis failure does not remove the durable row;
this is not an atomic outbox.
